task: The review-assurance floor counts fresh local PASS rounds keyed only on the whole-tree materialHash, so an unrelated main merge that drifts that hash makes a story's just-submitted quorum verdicts read as stale (0 fresh rounds), forcing a full re-bind; make the floor honor storyFilesHash as a secondary downgrade-accept exactly as the escalation path already does.
outcome: After an unrelated main merge drifts the whole-tree materialHash (story-owned files unchanged), the review-assurance floor evaluation reports the story's previously-submitted local PASS rounds as STILL VALID (count unchanged, ok=true) carrying a re-attestation advisory such as 'host verdict <id>: materialDigest drift accepted because storyFilesHash matches; re-attestation advisory required', instead of reporting 'review assurance floor requires N fresh local PASS round(s) ... found 0' and forcing a full quorum re-bind. A genuine story-owned-file change (storyFilesHash differs) still reports the rounds as stale (found 0), and the advisory is surfaced, not swallowed.
facts: The floor (packages/main/src/core/review-assurance-floor.ts) computes fresh local PASS rounds via evaluateHostVerdictRounds(readEvents,materialHash,hosts) at lines 501 and 509, keyed only on the whole-tree currentMaterialHash computed at line 439.

evaluateHostVerdictRounds is defined in packages/main/src/core/host-independence.ts:127; at line 154 it marks any host_verdict whose materialDigest != currentMaterialHash as materialDigest-is-stale and routes it to ignoredVerdicts, so a stale verdict never reaches the per-runId duplicate-host-identity check at line 192.

The escalation path (review-escalation.ts:431 evaluateReviewEscalation) ALREADY solves this: at lines 446-448 it pre-transforms events via eventsWithStoryFilesHashDowngrade(events,materialHash,storyFilesHash,advisories) (defined review-escalation.ts:408) BEFORE calling evaluateHostVerdictRounds, and passes storyFilesHash to its 3-arg latestFallbackRecord. The floor never applies that transform and uses a 2-arg latestFallbackRecord.

eventsWithStoryFilesHashDowngrade rewrites a stale host_verdict materialDigest to the current materialHash ONLY when its stored storyFilesHash === currentStoryFilesHash, pushing a re-attestation advisory; verdicts with no/differing storyFilesHash are left untouched (still stale).

currentStoryFilesHash(gitCwd,HEAD,metadataRoot) exists at evidence-freshness.ts:199 and is already used by escalation; host_verdict events and verdict records carry storyFilesHash (verdicts.ts:54/137/250; types.ts host_verdict event).

The floor already imports from ./review-escalation.js (lines 8-11) and ./evidence-freshness.js (line 2); evaluateHostVerdictRounds is shared by floor and escalation, so modifying it would change both paths.

Because stale-by-material verdicts are routed to ignoredVerdicts before the duplicate-identity check, truly-stale verdicts (stale by BOTH materialHash and storyFilesHash, hence not downgraded) are ALREADY excluded from the duplicate-identity check by construction; checklist item 2 is satisfied without altering evaluateHostVerdictRounds.
